title: tududi
name: tududi
description: Task manager for organising your life into areas, projects and tasks, with notes, tags, recurring tasks, Today and Upcoming views, and CalDAV sync with your other apps. Source: https://github.com/chrisvel/tududi

env.name: TUDUDI_EMAIL
env.label: Admin email
env.description: What you'll log in with. Doesn't need to be a real address.

env.name: TUDUDI_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password (required)
env.description: Anything long and hard to guess.

env.name: TUDUDI_SESSION_SECRET
env.label: Session secret (required)
env.description: Signs logins and encrypts saved notification settings. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 64

env.name: TUDUDI_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Set the admin password and session secret before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 64 makes a good secret), since the stack won't start without them. Then open http://<your-host>:3002 (or whichever port you picked) and log in with that email and password. The welcome page you land on first plays an intro video from YouTube. Sign-ups are off, so add other people from Access in the sidebar.The account is only made on the first start: changing the password here later does nothing (change it in your profile instead), and changing the email makes a second admin. Tasks, notes and settings live in tududi-db, attachments in tududi-uploads and backups in tududi-backups. Docs: docs.tududi.com
